Name: Downcycle Item Quality
Author: cardiacman
Description:
[b]Downcycle Item Quality[/b]
by cardiacman

Put a silver, gold or iridium item into a Recycling Machine to lower its quality by one tier. Each item takes 10 in-game minutes.

Iridium → Gold → Silver → Normal

The machine processes one item at a time. To lower it again, collect it and put it back in. Normal-quality items can't be downcycled. Ordinary trash recycling still works as usual.

Install

Requires Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later and SMAPI 4.4.0 or later on Windows, Mac or Linux.

Extract `DowncycleItemQuality` into your game's `Mods` folder, then launch through SMAPI. No other mods or configuration are needed. All players in a multiplayer game should install the same version.

Items and automation

Works with ordinary quality-bearing objects such as crops, fish and artisan goods. The output keeps the input's item ID and uses its normal copy behaviour for flavour, colour and custom data. Tools and furniture aren't accepted.

The recipes use the game's machine system. With Automate, items in connected chests can be fed back through until they reach normal quality. Keep items you want to retain at a higher quality outside that machine's input storage.

Mods that replace Recycler recipes or override machine output quality may change the result.

Remove

Collect any finished items, then delete the mod folder. Lowered quality is permanent.

Source and test notes are in `source`.
